note: Dei Filius ch. 3 para. 2 states that God willed to join external arguments of his revelation, miracles and prophecies, to the inner helps of the Spirit. That God actually revealed with signs entails that revealing with signs involves no contradiction. The premise is this modal consequence; the council asserts the actual revelation as a matter of faith, and the actuality is an open premise of its own, not established by this relation.
